absent: Full closure object layout and lifecycle beyond fields touched by the diagnostic.
Definition and protection rules for the global closure list and its lock.
File operations and permission handling backing the closures debugfs object.
Inner integer parser digit acceptance, overflow reporting and end pointer rules.
Validation mode caller contract for option list parsing when no capacity is supplied.
Radix tree node layout, fanout, tag set and shift constants.
Codetag descriptor callbacks, section names and unload or removal path.
Module and symbol lookup semantics used to resolve section bounds.

findings.text: Four weak pure helpers expose leading and trailing zero counts for 32 and 64 bit inputs by delegating to the kernel bit scan primitives for lowest set and highest set positions with width complement where needed.
A 256 entry read only byte table holds values zero through eight in doubling runs, starting with a single zero and single one and ending with a long run of eights.

The closures diagnostic walks every registered closure and reports its address plus saved instruction addresses, parent linkage and masked remaining count, adding markers for queued and running state and an extra line for the waited upon address when waiting.
The diagnostic holds the closure list spin lock in irq saving mode across the entire traversal and releases it before returning success.
A boot time initializer publishes a read only debugfs object for inspecting closures and always reports success.
Signed conversion handles a leading dash by negating the unsigned parse of the remainder, while narrower unsigned forms forward to the widest bounded parser with an effectively unlimited length.

When the caller passes zero as base, a leading zero followed by hex indicator selects sixteen, a plain leading zero selects eight, otherwise ten is chosen, and a hex prefix is skipped when the effective base is sixteen.

The bounded parser first normalizes base and prefix, then converts only within the remaining character budget, advances past consumed input including the case where the prefix alone exhausts the budget, and stores the stop position when requested.

Single option parsing rejects empty input, accepts an optional leading dash for negation with base auto detection, stores the value when a destination is supplied, and signals missing data versus comma continuation versus dash range versus final value through distinct return codes while advancing the cursor.
Dash range expansion fills successive integers starting at the current value up to but leaving the upper bound for the next iteration, bounded by remaining capacity, and returns the span width.

List parsing repeatedly consumes options into successive slots, expands dash ranges with index compensation, supports a validation scan that reuses one destination, records the consumed count in slot zero, and returns the stopped input position.

Memory size parsing converts a leading number with base auto detection then applies a binary suffix where each step from K upward adds ten bits of shift, consumes at most one suffix letter case insensitively only when digits preceded it, saturates shifted overflow to the maximum unsigned long long, and reports the stop position.
Option string search scans comma separated tokens and reports true only when the wanted text appears at a token start and is followed by end of string or a comma.

Argument splitting treats blanks as delimiters outside quoted regions, tracks quoted state toggled by quote characters, separates parameter and value at the first equals sign, strips outer quotes from values and quoted parameters, terminates the token in place, and returns the following non blank position.
Double word comparison orders by signed high halves first and unsigned low halves on tie, yielding distinct codes for less than, equal, and greater than.
A small union overlays four ordered bytes with a single 32 bit word to allow byte selection inside an aligned word.

Byte compare exchange is emulated by locating the containing aligned word and byte offset, then looping on word compare exchange with reread, selected byte comparison against expected, and installation of the new byte into a word copy until success or mismatch.

Because the emulation rewrites the whole aligned word, concurrent updates to sibling bytes in the same word cause retries and callers receive word granularity atomicity rather than isolated byte atomicity.

The codetag type record links into a global list, counts live tags, indexes per module records by integer identity, protects that index and sequence counters with a read write semaphore, carries a descriptor with tag size and callbacks, and maintains next sequence plus content generation numbers.
A range pairs start and stop tag pointers while a module record pairs an owning module pointer with such a range and a load sequence number.

Module list readers take shared ownership with blocking or try variants and release with the matching unlock, while registration takes exclusive ownership; content and count readers must already hold the semaphore and a global mutex object exists alongside.
Iterator creation binds the requested type and clears current module, tag, identity and sequence to start a fresh scan; the first tag helper yields null for empty spans.

Tag iteration moves through module identities in order, follows to the next present identity when one vanished, restarts at the span start after a module sequence change, otherwise steps by tag size, skips exhausted modules, and memoizes the found tag or null when none remain.
Identity lookup subtracts the configured base before delegating to the radix tree lookup.

Lookup loads the root optimistically, rejects indices beyond the advertised maximum, descends internal nodes recording parent and slot, restarts from the root on a retry marker, stops at the bottom level, and optionally outputs parent and slot for the caller.

Internal nodes are distinguished by a low tag bit with helpers to strip and compose the bit, and the addressable maximum for a shift is the map size scaled by that shift minus one, propagated from node to root load.

Next identity scan normalizes the cursor against the base, walks slots from that offset skipping empty entries and handling internal and retry markers, and on success updates the cursor to found index plus base while returning the entry, otherwise returns null.
Text rendering prints file name and line number always, adds bracketed module name when present, and appends function name.

Variadic buffer printing forwards to the core formatter which appends only when space remains and the result fits, otherwise marks overflow and reports failure, with a warning if the buffer size was zero.
Tag count for a span is the byte distance between stop and start divided by the configured per tag size.

Module registration resolves start and stop boundary symbols for the type section with preemption disabled, warns and rejects when either bound is missing, ignores empty spans, rejects inverted spans, allocates a module record, then under exclusive ownership assigns a fresh sequence and bumps content generation, allocates an identity, runs the optional load callback with rollback on failure, and charges the tag count only on success with cleanup on error.

Allocation rejects negative starts, ensures the tree carries the idr marker, rejects maxima below the base, locates a free slot from the normalized start within budget, publishes the pointer with tag maintenance under barrier semantics, and returns the numeric identity.

Slot replacement adjusts value accounting and child counts, installs the new item, then prunes empty ancestors upward clearing the root when emptied and shrinking single child chains, with node memory reclaimed asynchronously.

Shrinking refuses to collapse a bottom level idr entry zero into the root and poisons a collapsed direct child slot with a retry marker so lockless readers restart rather than observe a stale pointer.

Registration holds exclusive semaphore ownership across identity allocation and the optional module load callback, so that callback runs inside the critical section and must tolerate that holding context.
